description: The plot illustrates how two accuracy metrics (“Initial Accuracy” and “Final Accuracy”) vary with o_pop frequency. The x-axis is labeled “o_pop frequency (x10^4)” on a linear scale, with tick marks at 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 19 (range 1–19). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with regularly spaced ticks at 0.2 intervals. The “Initial Accuracy” series is shown as a green solid line with square markers and vertical error bars; it is about 0.34 at x=1, rises to about 0.49 at x=5, drops to about 0.29 at x=7, increases to about 0.52 at x=13, then declines to about 0.41 at x=19, with visibly larger error bars around x=17 than at earlier points. The “Final Accuracy” series is shown as a blue dashed line with circular markers and vertical error bars; it is about 0.65 at x=1, increases to about 0.86 at x=5, dips to about 0.72 at x=7, peaks near about 0.92 at x=9, drops to about 0.69–0.70 at x=11–13, then rises again to about 0.90 at x=15 and ends near about 0.90 at x=19, with error bars that are modest at most x-values and appear larger around x=13 and x=17.
caption_used: 1 of 2 plots in the figure, positioned at the bottom of the pair. This line plot depicts the relationship between 'o_pop frequency (x10^4)' on the x-axis and 'Accuracy' on the y-axis, spanning values from 0.0 to 1.0. The green solid line with square markers represents 'Initial Accuracy,' which begins at approximately 0.35, exhibits minor fluctuations, and stabilizes around 0.55 before declining sharply to 0.25 at the highest frequency (x = 19). The blue dashed line with circular markers denotes 'Final Accuracy,' starting at roughly 0.65, demonstrating a consistent upward trend with intermittent peaks, and ultimately reaching an accuracy of approximately 0.95 at x = 19. Notably, 'Final Accuracy' consistently exceeded 'Initial Accuracy' across all frequencies, with the gap widening significantly beyond x = 9, where error bars for 'Initial Accuracy' indicate substantial variability. The plot’s legend clarifies the distinction between the two accuracy metrics.
